offering_description.value: AZZ provides hot-dip galvanizing, coil coating and surface finishing for manufacturers and customers in construction and infrastructure. It performs the work through a network of facilities with specialized coating and processing capabilities.

quotes.quote: AZZ Inc. is North America’s leading independent provider of hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating solutions serving a broad range of end markets. Collectively, our business segments provide sustainable, unmatched metal coating solutions that enhance the longevity and appearance of the buildings, products and infrastructure people rely on every day.

AZZ combines large-scale galvanizing operations, integrated coil coating capabilities, and advanced surface technologies to help customers improve corrosion protection, operational efficiency, product quality, and long-term performance. Backed by an extensive network of facilities and specialized coating technologies, AZZ helps customers access the solutions, capacity, and technical support needed to meet changing business demands.
